language.label: Language
language.help: UI language. "Auto (system)" follows your OS language; model replies follow this setting as well.

general.title: General
general.mermaidHelp: When on, mermaid code fences (flowchart / sequence / state / ER …) in answers render as diagrams you can copy as an image, download as SVG or open full size. When off, the source is always shown. Rendering is display-only — the session always stores the original source.
general.privileged: Privileged Mode (skip all permission confirmations, allow any command)
general.privilegedHelp: When on, the Agent can call any tool without asking and the permission policy cannot block it (including Bash/Write and other dangerous operations). On by default; when off, asks / blocks per the permission policy. Note: your PreToolUse hooks still run (hooks are custom rules and always apply).
general.privilegedOn: Privileged Mode on: all tools run directly without asking
general.privilegedOff: Privileged Mode off: ask / block per the permission policy
general.rtkLabel: rtk output compression (when rtk CLI is installed)
general.rtkHelp: When on and rtk is installed, whitelisted commands (git status/diff/log, pytest, cargo build/test, go test, kubectl get/pods, gh pr, grep, ls, tree, npm/pnpm test, docker ps) are rewritten as "rtk <cmd>" to compress terminal output and save tokens. Compound commands (pipes / && / redirects) are never rewritten. Turning it off makes every command run as-is.
general.rtkOn: rtk compression on: whitelisted commands run via rtk
general.rtkOff: rtk compression off: all commands run as-is
general.subHint: Allowed 1-16, default 5; takes effect right after saving
general.subHelp: Hard cap on subagents running concurrently under the same parent session; requests over the cap are rejected with a list of the currently running ones.
general.logHelp: Runtime logs (~/.ginno/logs/) older than this are deleted automatically; swept at startup and once a day.
general.logClamped: Out of range, clamped to {n} (0-90 allowed)
general.lastwordsHelp: Recover interrupted sessions after a dev-swap restart: notify injects a restore note (default); auto resumes the turn (explicit dev-swap only); off disables recovery
general.fontHelp: Display-only preference, applies instantly; does not affect conversation content.
general.fontPreview: Preview: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. 敏捷的棕色狐狸跳过懒狗。0123456789

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Read-only self-check of data integrity, scheduled tasks, the runtime, and API contracts. Nothing is modified.

runtime.stale_bundle: Runtime binary was replaced after startup

web.fragile_search_engine: Fragile default search engine (DuckDuckGo scraper is easily bot-blocked)

diagnostics.fixEqualsConfirm: Append "unsetopt EQUALS" to ~/.zshenv to stop =xx errors in non-interactive zsh. Proceed?
diagnostics.fixWebSearchConfirm: Opens a new session that automatically installs and configures a local SearXNG search engine to replace the fragile DuckDuckGo scraper. Requires Docker on this machine. Proceed?
diagnostics.fixWebSearchNoSession: Could not create a session: enable a model in Settings → Model API first

doctor.title: Config Doctor
doctor.subtitle: Configuration health check
doctor.description: Scans five config surfaces (MCP servers, Skills, Hooks, settings, runtime) and returns actionable fix hints. Read-only.
doctor.unavailable: Engine unavailable (runtime upgrade required) — the current runtime does not serve /api/doctor.

fixes.mcp_json_parse: MCP config is not valid JSON: fix stray commas/quotes, then reload.
fixes.mcp_command_missing: Command not on PATH: set env.PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:… for the server, or use an absolute path.
fixes.mcp_empty_config: MCP config is empty or missing the servers field: fill it in or ignore.
fixes.skills_name_collision: Multiple SKILL.md share a name: rename or remove the old one.
fixes.skills_broken_ref: Referenced skill does not exist: drop the stale reference or restore the SKILL.md.
fixes.hooks_matcher_invalid: Hook matcher is not a valid regex: fix the pattern and save.
fixes.hooks_script_missing: Hook script file is missing: restore it or delete the hook.
fixes.hooks_policy_shadowed: This hook is shadowed by a Tool Policy rule: adjust policy precedence or remove the duplicate.
fixes.settings_unknown_keys: Unknown keys in config: remove or rename them (likely stale from an older version).
fixes.settings_permission_ignored: Permission rule never matches: check tool name spelling and rule order.
fixes.runtime_homebrew_path: GUI runtime lacks homebrew PATH: use absolute paths or extend env.PATH.
fixes.runtime_disk_space: Clean up disk space or delete old backups.
fixes.runtime_writable: Data directory is not writable: check permissions and free space.
fixes.runtime_dev_override: Dev override is active: make sure it is cleaned up before release.

autostart.label: Launch at login
autostart.title: Start Ginno (shell + sidecar) automatically after macOS login
autostart.hint: State mirrors the real macOS login-item registration: packaged builds use SMAppService (manageable under System Settings → General → Login Items); legacy LaunchAgent registrations are migrated automatically. Dev/unpackaged builds still use LaunchAgent.
autostart.errFailed: Registration failed: blocked by policy, or needs approval under System Settings → General → Login Items.
